 Delhi schools announce holiday on November 16 for Chhath Puja, DoE issues official notice
 Delhi schools will remain closed on November 16 for Chhath Puja. Bihar, Jharkhand and Uttar Pradesh have also announced holidays, with dates varying across schools and districts.
 Curated by Yash Wardhan Singh 
 Image: Canva 
 Nov 14, 2026
 Share
 Schools across Delhi will remain closed on November 16 due to Chhath Puja, according to an official order issued by the Directorate of Education. The holiday will apply to all government schools, government-aided schools and recognised private schools. All offices under the Directorate of Education, GNCTD, will also remain closed. 
 The notice states, “The Lieutenant Governor of the National Capital Territory of Delhi is pleased to declare 16th November, 2026 (Monday) to be a holiday in all Government Offices, Autonomous Bodies and Public Sector Undertakings under the Government of the National Capital Territory of Delhi, on account of Pratihar Shashthi or Surya Shashthi (Chhath Puja),” 
 This year, Chhath Puja is being celebrated from November 13 to November 16. The main day of the festival will be observed on November 15, 2026. 
 Chhath Puja is mainly celebrated in Bihar, Jharkhand and eastern Uttar Pradesh, also known as Purvanchal. As many students travel to their hometowns to celebrate the festival with their families, the authorities have declared November 16 a holiday. 
 Schools in Delhi will start functioning as usual from Tuesday. 
 Schools closed in Bihar, UP and Jharkhand for Chhath Puja 
 Apart from Delhi, several other states, including Bihar, Jharkhand, Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal, have also announced school holidays for Chhath Puja, also known as Pratihar Shashthi or Surya Shashthi. 
 In Bihar, many schools have reportedly been closed since November 7. The holidays are expected to continue until November 17. 
 In Uttar Pradesh, district administrations and individual schools have been given the responsibility of deciding the holiday dates. Several districts and schools have declared November 15 and 16 as holidays. 
 In Jharkhand, schools will remain closed from November 15 to November 17, 2026. 
 Students can use this break to visit their hometowns and celebrate Chhath Puja with their families. However, they should stay in contact with their schools for information about any changes or extension of the holidays.
